articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: What this year's $972 million crypto hacks actually tell us about security
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Immunefi's Mitchell Amador writes that most of 2026's stolen crypto is leaving through keys, signers and governance, not contract bugs, and explains why “we were audited” was never the same as “we are safe.”

articles.title: The 100x obsession: Fundamentals grow in importance as crypto matures
articles.snippet: Crypto’s fundamentals have never been stronger, yet degens keep chasing hot new narratives. Behavioral finance may explain why get rich quick stories continue to beat substance.
